findings.evidence: `FiniteBundleAtlas/Basic.lean:123` `closure_dom_subset_source : ∀ i, closure (dom i) ⊆ (chartAt E (center i)).source`; `ClosedDisc.lean:160` `def chartCenter (z : 𝕔𝔻) : ℂ := if 0 ≤ (z : ℂ).re then 1 else -1`; `ClosedDisc.lean:194` `chartAt ... z = cayleyChart (chartCenter z) ...`; roadmap line 79 defines a half-disc as `D⁺_r = {z ∈ ℍ̄ : |z| < r}`; roadmap line 1072 asks for 'one interior chart and four half-disc charts ... eight half-disc charts'.
findings.fix: Let `FiniteBundleAtlas` take chart maps from the maximal atlas (e.g. a field `chart i ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas`), not only `chartAt (center i)`. Then build genuine charts (Cayley at `c k`, rescaled onto `D⁺_r`, plus an interior chart) and prove the equivalence for those. Otherwise, drop the claim that the roadmap's disc check is done.
findings.issue: `fiveChartAtlas`/`eightChartAtlas` do not realize the roadmap check. Every chart is `chartAt (c k)` = Cayley chart at `chartCenter (c k)` ∈ {1, -1}: in the five-chart atlas, centres 0, 1, i, -i all use the Cayley chart at 1. No chart has image a half-disc `D⁺_r`, so the statement only compares two covers that use the same two coordinate maps.

findings.evidence: chartCenter I = chartCenter (-I) = chartCenter 0 = 1, since their real parts are ≥ 0 (`ClosedDisc.lean:160`).
findings.fix: State that each chart is the Cayley chart at `chartCenter (c k)` ∈ {±1} restricted to the domain, and drop 'half-disc chart' (or construct real half-disc charts as in the previous finding).
findings.issue: The module docstring and the `fiveChartAtlas`/`eightChartAtlas` docstrings call the charts 'half-disc charts', and the PR description says 'The charts are the Cayley charts at the centers'. In fact they are restrictions of the Cayley charts at ±1, not at `c k`, and their images are not half-discs.

findings.evidence: `FiniteBundleAtlas/Basic.lean:117-124`: the only chart data are `center` and `dom`; chart maps are `chartAt E (center i)`.
findings.fix: Scope the claim: the norm is independent of the choice of centres and domains among the preferred charts. Or generalize `FiniteBundleAtlas` to maximal-atlas charts before claiming full independence of the atlas.
findings.issue: The new docstring says '`W^{k,p}(V)` does not depend on the atlas', but `transfersTo_of_contMDiff` only covers `FiniteBundleAtlas`es, which use preferred charts `chartAt (center i)`. Other charts from the maximal atlas are not covered; on the closed disc only two coordinate maps exist.

summary: `transfersTo_of_contMDiff` is faithful, but the closed-disc check does not formalize the roadmap's 'one interior chart + four half-disc charts vs eight half-disc charts': every chart in both atlases is one of the two preferred Cayley charts (centred at ±1), so only the open cover changes. The docstrings and the PR description call these charts 'half-disc charts' and 'Cayley charts at the centers', and both are false.
